description: Schedule a task to be executed at a specific future time
execute_at: string (ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2026-07-10T15:30:00Z' or relative like '+2 hours', '+1 day')

action_to_execute.type: string (The action to perform when time is reached, e.g., 'send_reminder')
action_to_execute.payload: object (Any data needed for the action)
